title: Report open tasks that name a branch that no longer exists
body:
A handoff said t-9ser2tw's implementation "waits on branch feat/eval-checks"; the branch had been deleted with its worktree and the work survived only as dangling commit 52fad6c. The resume step trusted the sentence. scripts/claude/unpushed-delete.ts now refuses such deletes; this task covers the read side.
Acceptance: `bin/krn task check --evidence` reports an open task whose body names a branch (feat/..., fix/..., chore/...) that exists neither locally nor on origin, with the task id and branch name; a test drives it through the real CLI.
